description: This file defines the ClusterManifestSystemTarget class which manages cluster manifest data, updates, and lifecycle participation within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: ClusterManifestSystemTarget
classes.description: A sealed class that handles retrieval and caching of cluster manifest and update information, and participates in the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: GetClusterManifest
methods.description: Returns the current cluster manifest wrapped in a ValueTask.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves an updated cluster manifest if the version is newer, with internal caching to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: GetSiloManifest
methods.description: Returns the silo manifest associated with this system target.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Method for participating in the ILifecycle ISiloLifecycle, does nothing in this implementation.
